characteristics.label: Loans, advances, notes and receivables due from related parties ÷ total assets
characteristics.formula: largest lending amount in the related-party text ÷ XBRL total assets (clipped at 1)

characteristics.label: Loans, notes and amounts due to related parties ÷ total assets
characteristics.formula: largest payable amount ÷ XBRL total assets (clipped at 1)

characteristics.label: Revenue from related parties ÷ total revenue
characteristics.formula: largest sales amount ÷ XBRL revenue (clipped at 1)

characteristics.label: Purchases, fees, rent and services paid to related parties ÷ total assets
characteristics.formula: largest purchase amount ÷ XBRL total assets (clipped at 1)

characteristics.label: Incompleteness of the disclosure
characteristics.formula: (4 − items stated) ÷ 4; items: counterparty named, amount stated, terms stated, purpose stated

characteristics.label: Share of non-independent directors
characteristics.formula: 1 − (independent directors ÷ board size), from the proxy statement

characteristics.label: CEO duality
characteristics.formula: 1 if the chief executive also chairs the board

design_rules.value: the 862 analysed firm-years (five-year windows of the 31 matched sets); firm-years outside the windows and the external set are not ranked

design_rules.rule: layer score with a missing characteristic
design_rules.value: mean of the 0-1 ranks of the characteristics observed for that firm-year; a layer with no observed characteristic has no score
10 x mean of the layer scores that exist; a firm-year with no layer score has no AI_SCORE
modified (qualified, adverse, disclaimer) or going-concern opinion, from the audit report
8-K Item 4.02 or a 10-K/A that restates the financial statements

ai_flag.method: 0.95 quantile (linear interpolation) of the matched firm-years' AI_SCORE

logit.threshold_note: fixed for the ensemble alert at a clean-firm false-positive rate of at most 5 % (T5: 34 of 686 matched firm-years)

trained_on.note: the matched sets available when the model was fitted; the Gulfport set was added afterwards

earnings_cash_divergence.formula: (net income − operating cash flow) ÷ total assets, bounded ±1

accruals.formula: (net income − operating cash flow) ÷ lagged total assets, bounded ±1

icfr_not_effective.formula: 1 if Item 9A says internal control over financial reporting was not effective

material_weakness_reported.formula: 1 if a material weakness is reported

mw_persistence_2yr.formula: 1 if a material weakness was reported in this and the previous year

big4.formula: 1 if the signing auditor is Deloitte, EY, KPMG or PwC

ceo_duality.formula: 1 if the CEO chairs the board

ac_indep.formula: 1 if every audit-committee member is stated independent

auditor_change.formula: 1 if the signing auditor differs from the previous year

going_concern_opinion.formula: 1 if the audit report raises substantial doubt about going concern

restatement_8k.formula: 1 if an 8-K Item 4.02 was filed in the fiscal year

auditor_change_8k.formula: 1 if an 8-K Item 4.01 was filed in the fiscal year

rpt_transparency.formula: share of sentences stating counterparty, amount and term together

rpt_agency_masking.formula: share of clauses with the agent removed (agentless passives, nominalisations, existentials)

rpt_fog.formula: Gunning Fog index 0.4 × (words per sentence + 100 × share of 3-syllable words)

rpt_boilerplate_sim.formula: TF-IDF cosine similarity with the previous year's related-party text

spec_gap_vagueness.formula: vagueness of the related-party text minus vagueness of Item 1

listing_age.formula: years since the first annual report on EDGAR

rpt_vagueness_z.formula: leave-one-out z-score of vagueness within the set-year

rpt_agency_masking_z.formula: leave-one-out z-score of agency masking within the set-year

rpt_fog_z.formula: leave-one-out z-score of Fog within the set-year

earnings_cash_divergence_z.formula: leave-one-out z-score of earnings–cash divergence within the set-year

accruals_z.formula: leave-one-out z-score of accruals within the set-year

rpt_peer_text_distance.formula: 1 − cosine(TF-IDF of the firm's related-party text, centroid of its set-year peers)

text_risk.formula: stacked TF-IDF logistic-regression probability on the related-party text (nested folds)

m1.panel_column: modified (qualified, adverse, disclaimer) or going-concern opinion, from the audit report
8-K Item 4.02 or a 10-K/A that restates the financial statements

exploratory_fitted.note: EXPLORATORY: the fitted ensemble score uses 36 inputs including ICFR, audit-opinion, auditor-change and restatement signals, Big-4 status and general financial ratios; it cannot test whether the RPT layers add to the benchmark

labels.design_primary: The design tests (H1–H5, P1, A1–A3) on the rank-averaged AI risk score are the primary results.
labels.fitted_exploratory: The fitted 36-input model contains the traditional signals and is exploratory; it does not test H5.
labels.identification_not_prediction: All results are associations within matched sets that identify fraud already under way, not predictions.
